levels.L2: interface evidence: logit_interface and S_interface/top-M contacts
levels.L3: global pair evidence: logit_pair_raw and p_pair_raw

physical_interaction_output.name: p_PPI
physical_interaction_output.symmetric_inference: run A-B and B-A; average each branch logit; apply sigmoid after logit averaging
physical_interaction_output.dense_interface_policy: S_interface is an exact on-demand output, not a mandatory all-pair stored artifact; the frozen checkpoint, registry row, ESM arrays and inference contract are sufficient to regenerate it, while Top-M interfaces and L2-to-L1 projections are retained for every pair
physical_interaction_output.calibration_rule: do not recalibrate on OSA discovery or validation; use a calibration frozen on disease-independent PPI data only
physical_interaction_output.threshold_rule: rank all pairs continuously; no OSA-specific binary threshold

traceability.reliability_interpretation: diagnostic evidence consistency only; not calibrated uncertainty
traceability.gate_interpretation: sample-specific model-internal evidence reliance; not causal biology

features.PSSM_policy: checkpoint-dependent; complete matched coverage is required when enabled in the selected checkpoint unless a disease-independent ESM-only/feature-dropout checkpoint is trained and frozen
features.DSSP_policy: checkpoint-dependent; complete matched coverage is required when enabled in the selected checkpoint unless a disease-independent ESM-only/feature-dropout checkpoint is trained and frozen
features.explicit_missing_PSSM_DSSP_fill: zero only with per-protein availability tier exported and tier-matched controls
features.primary_max_length_policy: explicitly crop every protein to residues 1..checkpoint max_pair_len, reproducing the frozen checkpoint training loader; export full length, used length and truncation flag
features.primary_policy_reason: the disease-independent base model was trained with deterministic N-terminal truncation, so changing aggregation in the primary analysis would alter its estimand
features.multi_window_sensitivity: allowed only as a separately registered sensitivity analysis after checkpoint audit; it may not replace the checkpoint-native primary result
features.feature_adaptation_training_data: original disease-independent PPI/interface training partitions only; no OSA, CPAP or external validation outcomes

OSA_context.initial_mode: disease-independent TUnA missing-modality adaptation followed by frozen OSA inference
OSA_context.fine_tuning_status: OSA fine-tuning forbidden; one TUnA-only ESM/no-structure feature-domain adaptation is authorized and must be frozen before OSA inference
